start.title: [TODO:de] The Upper Room
start.text:
[TODO:de] The hour has come. Twelve faces wait by lamplight.
You step inside the prepared room.

send_consequence.title: [TODO:de] Stay With Me
send_consequence.text:
[TODO:de] This night is for them too.
They must see what love does.

glory_consequence.title: [TODO:de] Not Tonight
glory_consequence.text:
[TODO:de] Tonight is bread, and cup, and love.
Glory waits beyond the cross.

gathered.title: [TODO:de] A Basin of Water
gathered.text:
[TODO:de] Dust covers their feet. No servant has come.
A folded towel waits by the door.

choices.text: [TODO:de] Order Peter to wash the feet
[TODO:de] Rise and tie the towel on

order_consequence.title: [TODO:de] Show, Not Tell
order_consequence.text:
[TODO:de] If you wish them to serve, serve first.
The master kneels tonight.

choices.text: [TODO:de] Rise and tie the towel on
choices.feedback: [TODO:de] You take the basin in hand.

leave_consequence.title: [TODO:de] Love Stoops Low
leave_consequence.text:
[TODO:de] You came to wash more than feet.
Begin with what is small.

choices.text: [TODO:de] Rise and tie the towel on

washing.title: [TODO:de] Peter Resists
washing.text:
[TODO:de] "Lord, you shall never wash my feet!"
His voice cracks with shame.

choices.feedback: [TODO:de] Then he has no part in you.

choices.text: [TODO:de] Tell him he must be washed
choices.feedback: [TODO:de] Peter offers his head and hands.

agree_consequence.title: [TODO:de] He Must Be Washed
agree_consequence.text:
[TODO:de] Unless he lets you serve him,
he cannot walk the road ahead.

choices.text: [TODO:de] Tell him he must be washed

rebuke_consequence.title: [TODO:de] Gently
rebuke_consequence.text:
[TODO:de] His pride hides a frightened heart.
Meet him with truth, not fire.

choices.text: [TODO:de] Tell him he must be washed

bread_table.title: [TODO:de] The Loaf in Your Hands
bread_table.text:
[TODO:de] The unleavened bread rests on the cloth.
The room falls quiet around it.

choices.text: [TODO:de] Hide the loaf and say nothing

choices.feedback: [TODO:de] "This is my body, given for you."
[TODO:de] This bread is for all of them.

hide_consequence.title: [TODO:de] Let Them See
hide_consequence.text:
[TODO:de] Memory is built from this moment.
Give what cannot be hidden.

alone_consequence.title: [TODO:de] For All of Them
alone_consequence.text:
[TODO:de] The bread is broken to be shared.
None eat it alone tonight.

cup_lifted.title: [TODO:de] The Cup of Wine
cup_lifted.text:
[TODO:de] Dark wine glows in the clay cup.
You lift it slowly above the table.

choices.feedback: [TODO:de] Pass it around, all of you.

choices.text: [TODO:de] Pour it out upon the floor
choices.feedback: [TODO:de] This is the cup of covenant.

choices.text: [TODO:de] Pass it and speak of covenant

quiet_consequence.title: [TODO:de] Share the Cup
quiet_consequence.text:
[TODO:de] The new covenant is given to them.
Not kept hidden in your hand.

choices.text: [TODO:de] Pass it and speak of covenant

pour_consequence.title: [TODO:de] Not the Floor
pour_consequence.text:
[TODO:de] This cup is to be drunk, not spilled.
Let them taste the promise.

choices.text: [TODO:de] Pass it and speak of covenant
choices.feedback: [TODO:de] The cup moves down the table.

remembrance.title: [TODO:de] Do This in Memory
remembrance.text:
[TODO:de] Their eyes follow your every word.
How will they keep this night?

choices.text: [TODO:de] Tell them to forget the meal

choices.feedback: [TODO:de] The words settle deep in them.

choices.text: [TODO:de] Demand a feast in your name

forget_consequence.title: [TODO:de] Always Remember
forget_consequence.text:
[TODO:de] This bread, this cup, this love.
These they must never forget.

demand_consequence.title: [TODO:de] Memory, Not Spectacle
demand_consequence.text:
[TODO:de] A quiet meal, broken and shared.
That is enough for love.

betrayal_words.title: [TODO:de] One of You
betrayal_words.text:
[TODO:de] Your voice grows low and sorrowful.
"One who eats with me will betray me."

choices.text: [TODO:de] Let the words fall and wait

accuse_consequence.title: [TODO:de] Not by Force
accuse_consequence.text:
[TODO:de] He must come to his own choice.
Love does not shame him publicly.

choices.text: [TODO:de] Let the words fall and wait

take_back_consequence.title: [TODO:de] Truth Stands
take_back_consequence.text:
[TODO:de] What is true must be spoken,
even when it wounds your heart.

choices.text: [TODO:de] Let the words fall and wait

disciples_ask.title: [TODO:de] "Is It I, Lord?"
disciples_ask.text:
[TODO:de] One by one they look up troubled.
"Surely not I, Lord? Surely not I?"

choices.text: [TODO:de] Point your finger at each one

point_consequence.title: [TODO:de] Let Hearts Speak
point_consequence.text:
[TODO:de] Each soul must look within tonight.
Do not crush them with judgment.

laugh_consequence.title: [TODO:de] Not a Jest
laugh_consequence.text:
[TODO:de] Their fear is honest and tender.
Meet it with honest love.

farewell.title: [TODO:de] Love One Another
farewell.text:
[TODO:de] The hour grows late. Lamps burn low.
What last word will you give?

choices.text: [TODO:de] "Love one another, as I have loved"

leave_silent_consequence.title: [TODO:de] One Last Word
leave_silent_consequence.text:
[TODO:de] They will need it in the dark hours.
Let love be the lamp you leave.

choices.text: [TODO:de] "Love one another, as I have loved"
choices.feedback: [TODO:de] You bless them with your gaze.

warn_consequence.title: [TODO:de] Love First
warn_consequence.text:
[TODO:de] Fear cannot carry them through.
Only love will hold them.

choices.text: [TODO:de] "Love one another, as I have loved"
choices.feedback: [TODO:de] Your voice is gentle and clear.

ending.title: [TODO:de] Into the Night
ending.text:
[TODO:de] You rise from the table together.
The night waits beyond the door.
